Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: environment layout / watercolor style ONLY. Keep the geography and furnishings, but draw ONLY the requested people and props for this shot, never copy unwanted actors. This is not an image to reuse as the output.
Visible characters: NONE; no animals or people visible. Exact total number of visible characters: 0. Do not draw extra background animals. Scene continuity: imagined_calm_cove；柔和的内心联想画面
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 纯溪流意象：清澈溪水经过同一块溪中央大圆石后变缓，平静水面反光柔和；不出现任何角色、床铺或屋内元素。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 保持角色身份一致；表情、目光、耳姿与身体动作贴合本镜具体旁白，温和自然，不复制参考图的默认表情；水彩竖屏9:16；无字无水印；重要脸部和动作避开字幕区。

Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events.
